content: OpenRouter chat completions: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions, Authorization Bearer key, body with model (vendor/model string), messages, response_format, stream, temperature, max_completion_tokens. OpenAI SDK compatible by setting base_url to openrouter.ai/api/v1. Streaming returns text/event-stream chat.completion.chunk objects with delta content terminated by DONE sentinel. Official docs, HIGH confidence.
